subject.title: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Board, Area 5

text: For more than 30 years, I have dedicated my career to educating, mentoring, and advocating for children. Today, I am honored to continue that commitment as your elected representative on the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Board of Education.

As a proud parent whose children attended our district schools, I have a personal investment in ensuring every student receives the opportunities, support, and quality education they deserve. My commitment to this district extends beyond my role as a Board member it is rooted in my family's experience and my lifelong service to public education.

As your trustee, I have worked to be a thoughtful listener, a strong advocate for all students, and a responsible steward of taxpayer dollars. I believe every decision should be guided by facts, integrity, accountability, and transparency, especially when it comes to the district's financial resources and long-term planning.

I remain committed to putting students first, supporting our dedicated educators and staff, and working collaboratively with families and the community to strengthen our schools. I respectfully ask for your continued trust and support as we build on our progress and prepare every student for a successful future.

text: Occupation: Nurse Manager/Parent

As a mother raising two young boys in Hacienda Heights, I understand every parent wants their child to feel safe, supported, challenged, and prepared for the future. I decided to run because I realized I didn't have to wait until my children started school to help shape their future.

As a nurse manager, I lead teams, manage budgets, implement policies, promote accountability, and make thoughtful decisions every day. I will bring that same leadership, integrity, collaboration, and responsibility to our schools.

I believe parents deserve a voice, teachers deserve support, students deserve opportunities to succeed, and every decision should put children first. I will listen respectfully, work collaboratively, and make informed decisions that strengthen trust between families and our district.
I am committed to fostering safe, inclusive, and transparent schools where every student feels valued and has the opportunity to succeed.
I am not a career politician. I am a parent who cares deeply about our community and wants to help ensure every child has the opportunity to succeed.
It would be an honor to earn your trust and your vote for Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Trustee Area 5.
Together, We Can Make Every Voice Count

text: Age: 63
Occupation: Retired/Broker

As a lifelong resident of Hacienda Heights (35+ years), my wife and I raised 5 children (3 boys and 2 girls) in this School District. I have been an HLPUSD and community leader because we love Hacienda Heights.

- Former Bank of America Regional Manager
- Built Mortgage and Real Estate Business helping families achieve the Dream of Home Ownership.
- My 5 children attended elementary, middle and High School in HLPUSD.
- US Naval Academy -- 2 of my Children went here.
- My other Children -- Finance Executive, City Employee.
- My beautiful wife worked for HLPUSD for over 25 years.
- Los Altos High School – Helped raise $200,000 as Football Booster Club President
- Wilson High School – Helped raise $300,000 as Football Booster Club President, Booster of Girls Water Polo, and Track & Field
- Former Chair of HLPUSD's Personnel Commission
- Former President of Hacienda Heights Kiwanis Club
- Former PTA Council

I support STEM Programs (Science, Technology, Engineering, & Math) because our kids must thrive in today's New Economy. I will expand the Chinese, Spanish, and Korean language programs because language and culture are important.
We must always protect the Financial Health of HLPUSD, and always put our Children First!
Honored to Have Your Vote!
